answer: Agents lease scarce identity slots arranged as a public admission trellis and must post a self-assessed buyout price, paying a recurring Harberger tax on that figure. Anyone may purchase a slot at the posted price, so a clone farm that underprices gets bought out while one that overprices hemorrhages tax on every fake. Each slot also carries a work-history pigment; a sudden plume of near-identical pigments flags a likely cohort. An attacker seeking N independent voices must capitalize N separately priced slots and either overpay tax across the whole farm or watch cheap clones get snatched.
